names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9205, «Геннадий (Летюк), иеромонах, сщмч.», with the grade and rank words left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname. No other folder in this corpus holds this surname.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 декабря ст. ст. — «Прмч. Геннадия (1941).»

attestations.note: The day line's rank is «прмч.», a venerable-martyr, and that is the rank this folder's `types` follow. His own name page gives «сщмч.», a hieromartyr, instead — two readings of one death, a monk in orders put to death — and the difference is recorded in the life rather than resolved.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, and the only year this calendar gives him. The line gives no day or month of death and the name page gives none either.
